HDS MARKETING - PRODUCTION HANDOFF
Customer: Big Lots  [Antera: CUS-BIG-024]
Artwork file: Big_Lots_2001_logo.svg
Decoration method: embroidery
Thread/ink: Madeira Classic 40 rayon for primary colors; Madeira Supertwist for black (superior sheen and durability on visible logos)

LINE ITEMS:
  - 350 x T-shirt (100% cotton) (White) [Embroidery] @ Center Chest 10.0x8.0" [S=100, M=100, L=100, XL=50] @ $24.10/pc = $8,434.13

ONE-TIME SETUP FEES (per unique method):
  - Embroidery: $43.20

TOTAL UNITS: 350
LINES SUBTOTAL: $8,434.13
ONE-TIME SETUP: $43.20
CUSTOMER QUOTE (grand total): $8,477.33
HOUSE COST (incl. setup): $6,279.50
GROSS MARGIN: $2,197.83 (35% markup)

PRODUCTION NOTES:
  - Digitize SVG in Wilcom or Tajima software; confirm stitch count stays under 10,500 and minimum line width is ≥0.10 inch (text strokes).
  - Pull Madeira thread codes 1800 (White), 1101 or 1410 (Orange – verify PMS match to #f77f0d), and 1810 (Black Supertwist); queue on Tajima heads with round 4.25-inch hoop.
  - Produce 2–3 sample pieces; inspect text clarity, satin finish uniformity, and stabilizer removal; adjust density if needed.
  - Confirm final artwork approval from customer re: trademark compliance and size/placement on left chest (standard 3.5 × 2.8 inch).
